A '''storm barrier generator''' was installed on [[Gavos]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], in order to protect [[Miner/Legends|miners]] against sand storms and [[Acid rain/Legends|acid rains]]. Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[EV-8D3]], an [[EV-series supervisor droid/Legends|EV-series supervisor droid]], tried to kill the miners by destroying the storm barrier generator to spread throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] its [[New Droids' Rights Movement]], a violent rebellion against organic life forms.
